desc.ian_image_library:title: Stolephorus commersonnii (Commerson's Anchovy)
desc.ian_image_library:descr: The Commerson's anchovy (Stolephorus commersonnii), also known as Devis's anchovy, Long-jawed anchovy, Teri anchovy, is a species of anadromous fish in the Engraulidae family. It is widely used as a live or dead bait in tuna fishery.
